event.name: personal_ai.golden.completed

adapter_design.deterministic_sub_id: sub_ + sha256(principal | callback url | name | canonical-json(arguments))[:32]

ttl.ttlMs_null_default: finite (no-expiry only if explicitly allowed policy)

security_controls.auth: events/subscribe and events/unsubscribe require the existing authenticated MCP scope (hasWriteScope); principal/account captured from the token
security_controls.account_scoping: subscription identity includes authenticated principal; cross-account unsubscribe derives a different id and cannot remove another account's subscription
security_controls.ttl_refresh: refreshBefore returned; interval subscriptions refresh idempotently by identity; ttlMs bounded to [min, default]
security_controls.idempotency: duplicate subscribe returns same deterministic id; duplicate event delivery preserves eventId; canonical JSON argument comparison ignores key order
security_controls.callback_private_ip_rejection: resolved addresses validated at connection time; loopback/link-local/private/reserved/multicast/unspecified/CGNAT blocked
security_controls.redirect_rejection: fetch uses redirect:error; redirects never followed (verification and delivery)
security_controls.signature: Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 over exact serialized bytes of msg_id.timestamp.body; constant-time compare; timestamp tolerance
security_controls.secret_validation: whsec_ prefix, base64 decodes to 24-64 bytes
security_controls.no_secret_disclosure: secrets referenced by sha256 fingerprint only in artifacts; no callback URL or secret in logs/evidence
security_controls.input_payload_validation: JSON schema validation of name, arguments (required + additionalProperties:false), delivery.mode
security_controls.size_bound: one event per request, complete body <= 256 KiB (262144 bytes)
security_controls.retries: bounded attempts with backoff; preserve eventId; fresh timestamp/signature per attempt; stop (no retry) on 410/413
security_controls.access_revocation: delivery skips subscriptions whose account access is revoked or which are expired

blockers_and_dependencies.description: Implemented code cannot be committed under the PREP allowlist (only the two outputs files are writable). The adapter is delivered as a reviewable proposed patch inside the release plan; applying it requires a Human Gate with an expanded allowlist.

Subscription operational state and signing secrets are stored in the existing TASK_REGISTRY KV. This reuses the existing binding (no schema/binding/permission change) but storing signing secrets requires a Human Gate security review before production.

Live production version of personal-ai-execution-mcp cannot be verified without Cloudflare credentials; worker/PRODUCTION-BASELINE.json (3e2fed43) conflicts with the task-declared 1b6a318a (which is a Pages WebAuthn artifact).

The current Worker speaks protocol 2025-06-18 and has no server/discover. Adding MCP 2.0 / 2026-07-28 server/discover is additive but must be reviewed for OAuth resource-metadata and client handshake compatibility.
